correctness.rationale: The recursive family enumeration is exhaustive by choosing increasing ordered vertices and retaining only pairwise-intersecting families. Independently reconstructed exact f-vector for sizes 0..15, total 1,278,686 faces including empty. The inspected C++17 source generates a complete greedy Morse matching, checks acyclicity by traversal of every matched upper cell, and constructs signed gradient-path Morse differentials (not simply a saved log). Independently fetched and checked all six actual integer matrix certificate blobs: forward matrices 60x41,41x11,11x8 have exact unit-invariant ranks 31,10,1; reverse matrices 45x27,27x16,16x12 have unit-invariant ranks 16,11,5; in both sets every consecutive matrix composition vanishes, and independent BigInt unimodular row/column elimination leaves only zero residual blocks. Therefore both certify Htilde6=Z^29 and Htilde9=Z^7, all other homology zero, no torsion. Source generator was inspected but not rerun in this audit; certificate provenance ultimately depends on the inspected generator matching the submitted matrices.
residual_risks: The complete original C++ generator was not independently compiled/executed this run, so the link between its reconstructed faces/matching and stored matrices was code-reviewed rather than separately re-generated; stored matrices are checked mathematically and agree for two distinct matchings.
The exact homology does not prove a wedge-of-spheres homotopy type.
